owner_calls.question: In Luke Cage S1 episode 12, Zip sides with Diamondback against Shades and Mariah and joins Diamondback's crew. The record files this as leaving to Independent (left: Luke Cage S1). But the dataset files Diamondback himself in The Stokes Crime Family, so Zip arguably stays in the same group (or joins an unnamed Diamondback crew). Which is it?
options: Keep as is: Stokes Crime Family, then Independent, left Luke Cage S1
Zip stays in The Stokes Crime Family (drop the Independent stage and the left title), matching Diamondback's file
Add a new group for Diamondback's crew from Luke Cage S1 (the screen gives it no name)
owner_calls.evidence: Luke Cage S1 episode 12 (Soliloquy of Chaos): Diamondback offers Zip Shades' spot; Turk Barrett tells Zip his father Romeo would be disgusted that he turned on the Stokes and joined Diamondback; Diamondback sends Zip to kill Shades and Shades kills him.

owner_calls.question: At the end of Spider-Man (1994) episode 60 (The Return of Hydro-Man, Part Two) Warren calls Silvermane's side to rebuild his lab. Marvel Database calls Silvermane his current employer and lists the Maggia; Marvel Animated lists Silvermane only as an ally (he calls Alistair Smythe to have Silvermane's men rebuild the lab). Should the record add Silvermane's Mob from Spider-Man (1994), or is this a funder/ally, not membership?
owner_calls.evidence: Episode 60: after the clones dissolve, Warren keeps a scrap of Spider-Man's suit and contacts his backer Silvermane (via Smythe) to rebuild his lab.
